          Regulation Comparison

          Cumulative counts assume each regulation's legal pool is a superset of the previous one (Regulation B shown as B ∪ A). PokéBase (the source of this data) never publishes a removal signal, so a cumulative count can only grow — if a Pokémon were actually banned in a later regulation, this count would keep including it anyway. Treat these as an upper bound, not a confirmed current pool.
